test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements is correct?

a)The Indian desert lies towards the eastern margins of the Aravali Hills. It is an undulating sandy plain covered with sand dunes.

b) This region has arid climate with low vegetation cover and streams appear during the rainy season.

options.text: Both a and b are correct.
Both a and b are incorrect.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Only b is correct.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Indian desert, also known as the Thar Desert, lies towards the western margins of the Aravali Hills, not the eastern margins.
 
• It is indeed an undulating sandy plain covered with sand dunes.
 
• This region has an arid climate with low vegetation cover.
 
• Streams in the Thar Desert appear only during the rainy season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thar Desert:**

 
 
• The Thar Desert, also known as the Great Indian Desert, is a large arid region in the northwestern part of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It forms a natural boundary between India and Pakistan.
 
• The desert extends over an area of about 200,000 square kilometers (77,000 sq mi).
 
 
 
• **Aravali Hills:**
 
 
• The Aravali Range is a range of mountains in western India running approximately 670 kilometers (430 mi) in a south-west direction, starting near Delhi, passing through southern Haryana and Rajasthan, and ending in Gujarat.
 
• It is one of the oldest mountain ranges in the world.
 
 
 
• **Climate of the Thar Desert:**
 
 
• The climate of the Thar Desert is characterized by extreme temperatures, with summer temperatures rising as high as 50°C and winter temperatures dropping below 0°C.
 
• Rainfall is very low, typically ranging between 100 to 500 mm annually.
 
 
 
• **Vegetation in the Thar Desert:**
 
 
• Vegetation is sparse and consists mainly of xerophytic (drought-resistant) plants such as cacti, acacias, and grasses.
 
• During the short rainy season, some ephemeral plants may also grow.
